event.title: Lab0 announced its public launch
event.summary: Lab0 announced its public launch in a dated company video.

evidence.title: Lab0 (YC P26) Launch Video
evidence.excerpt: Lab0 builds AI agents that turn enterprise software from a consulting-heavy deployment into a self-serve product. Every rollout, whether it's a traditional ERP or a new AI system, requires months of manual integration, configuration, and tuning done by armies of system integrators and forward-deployed engineers. Lab0 builds agentic systems that automate this layer, compressing months-long implementations into weeks.
